text: And if any one{H5315} sin,{H2398} in that he heareth{H8085} the voice{H6963} of adjuration,{H423} he being a witness,{H5707} whether{H176} he hath seen{H7200} or known,{H3045} if he do not utter{H5046} [it], then he shall bear{H5375} his iniquity.{H5771}

Or if any one{H5315} touch{H5060} any unclean{H2931} thing,{H1697} whether it be the carcass{H5038} of an unclean{H2931} beast,{H2416} or the carcass{H5038} of unclean{H2931} cattle,{H929} or the carcass{H5038} of unclean{H2931} creeping things,{H8318} and it be hidden{H5956} from him, and he be unclean,{H2931} then he shall be guilty.{H816}

Or if he touch{H5060} the uncleanness{H2932} of man,{H120} whatsoever his uncleanness{H2932} be wherewith he is unclean,{H2930} and it be hid{H5956} from him; when he knoweth{H3045} of it, then he shall be guilty.{H816}

Or if any one{H5315} swear{H7650} rashly{H981} with his lips{H8193} to do evil,{H7489} or to do good,{H3190} whatsoever it be that a man{H120} shall utter rashly{H981} with an oath,{H7621} and it be hid{H5956} from him; when he knoweth{H3045} of it, then he shall be guilty{H816} in one{H259} of these [things].
And it shall be, when he shall be guilty{H816} in one{H259} of these [things], that he shall confess{H3034} that wherein he hath sinned:{H2398}

and he shall bring{H935} his trespass-offering{H817} unto Jehovah{H3068} for his sin{H2403} which he hath sinned,{H2398} a female{H5347} from the flock,{H6629} a lamb{H3776} or a{H8166} goat,{H8166} for a sin-offering;{H2403} and the priest{H3548} shall make atonement{H3722} for him as concerning his sin.{H2403}

And if his{H3027} means suffice not{H1767} for{H5060} a lamb,{H7716} then he shall bring{H5060} his{H854} trespass-offering{H817} for that wherein he hath sinned,{H2398} two{H8147} turtle-doves,{H8449} or two{H8147} young{H1121} pigeons,{H3123} unto Jehovah;{H3068} one{H259} for a sin-offering,{H2403} and the other{H259} for a burnt-offering.{H2403}

And he shall bring{H935} them unto the priest,{H3548} who shall offer{H7126} that which is for the sin-offering{H2403} first,{H7223} and wring off{H4454} its head{H7218} from{H4136} its neck,{H6203} but shall not divide it asunder:{H914}

and he shall sprinkle{H5137} of the blood{H1818} of the sin-offering{H2403} upon the side{H7023} of the altar;{H4196} and the rest{H7604} of the blood{H1818} shall be drained out{H4680} at the base{H3247} of the altar:{H4196} it is a sin-offering.{H2403}

And he shall offer{H6213} the second{H8145} for a burnt-offering,{H5930} according to the ordinance;{H4941} and the priest{H3548} shall make atonement{H3722} for him as concerning his sin{H2403} which he hath sinned,{H2398} and he shall be forgiven.{H5545}

But if his{H3027} means suffice{H5381} not for two{H8147} turtle-doves,{H8449} or two{H8147} young{H1121} pigeons,{H3123} then he shall bring{H935} his oblation{H7133} for that wherein he hath sinned,{H2398} the tenth{H6224} part of an ephah{H374} of fine flour{H5560} for a sin-offering:{H2403} he shall put{H7760} no oil{H8081} upon it, neither shall he put{H5414} any frankincense{H3828} thereon; for it is a sin-offering.{H2403}

And he shall bring{H935} it to the priest,{H3548} and the priest{H3548} shall take{H7061} his handful{H4393} of it as the memorial{H234} thereof, and burn{H6999} it on the altar,{H4196} upon the offerings of Jehovah{H3068} made by fire:{H801} it is a sin-offering.{H2403}

And the priest{H3548} shall make atonement{H3722} for him as touching his sin{H2403} that he hath sinned{H2398} in any{H259} of these things, and he shall be forgiven:{H5545} [and the remnant] shall be the priest's,{H3548} as the meal-offering.{H4503}
And Jehovah{H3068} spake{H1696} unto Moses,{H4872} saying,{H559}

If any one{H5315} commit{H4603} a trespass,{H4604} and sin{H2398} unwittingly,{H7684} in the holy things{H6944} of Jehovah;{H3068} then he shall bring{H935} his trespass-offering{H817} unto Jehovah,{H3068} a ram{H352} without blemish{H8549} out of the flock,{H6629} according to thy estimation{H6187} in silver{H3701} by shekels,{H8255} after the shekel{H8255} of the sanctuary,{H6944} for a trespass-offering:{H817}

and he shall make restitution{H7999} for that which he hath done amiss{H2398} in the holy thing,{H6944} and shall add{H3254} the fifth part{H2549} thereto, and give{H5414} it unto the priest;{H3548} and the priest{H3548} shall make atonement{H3722} for him with the ram{H352} of the trespass-offering,{H817} and he shall be forgiven.{H5545}

And if any one{H5315} sin,{H2398} and do{H6213} any{H259} of the things which Jehovah{H3068} hath commanded{H4687} not to be done;{H6213} though he knew{H3045} it not, yet is he guilty,{H816} and shall bear{H5375} his iniquity.{H5771}

And he shall bring{H935} a ram{H352} without blemish{H8549} out of the flock,{H6629} according to thy estimation,{H6187} for a trespass-offering,{H817} unto the priest;{H3548} and the priest{H3548} shall make atonement{H3722} for him concerning the thing wherein he erred{H7683} unwittingly{H7684} and knew{H3045} it not, and he shall be forgiven.{H5545}
It is a trespass-offering:{H817} he is certainly{H816} guilty{H816} before Jehovah.{H3068}
